generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The bidder should have executed as a prime contractor in a single contract in Routine/ Preventive, Breakdown Electrical maintenance works pertaining to Generator & its auxiliaries in any Thermal Power Stations of capacity 210 MW or above in any public/private Utilities for an amount of not less than Rs.53.70 Lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any one of the preceding Five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and should upload the Work order and relevant Work done certificate issued by the competent authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer or equivalent. On demand original shall be produced for verification. Work done value for previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year (Maximum 50% only) to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and relevant Work done certificates

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Class-I or above, Electrical Contractor License issued by Electrical Inspectorate, Government of Karnataka. If the electrical license is issued by other than GOK, the successful bidder should submit Electrical License from Electrical Inspectorate to Government of Karnataka within Two months from the date of issue of Work order.

The Bidder should have achieved minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.215 Lakhs in any two of the preceding Five financial years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26). The Bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year (Maximum 50% only) to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tender is invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Registration of Establishment / firm / company / individual from Govt. authority, Department of Labour.
PF Registration certificate from Regional Provident Fund Commissioner.
PAN CARD photocopy and Income tax Returns filed for the last two financial years i.e., 2024-25 and 2025-26.

The declaration by the bidder that none of his contracts have been terminated / foreclosed by KPCL or elsewhere at the time of submission of bid shall be furnished as per the Bid document as per the Annexure-III.
Declaration by the bidder for conforming to contract terms & conditions as per Annexure-IV.
Undertaking by Bidder as per Annexure-V.
The Bidder shall furnish self-declaration that the employees working under him at KPCL site shall not claim for employment in KPCL at any point of time, if the contract is awarded as per Annexure-VI.
Declaration by the bidder on Medical Fitness Certificates for Workmen as per Annexure-VII.
Declaration by the bidder on Safety Practices and Accident Reporting as per Annexure-VIII.
